#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
 DEFENCE TECHNOLOGY - Q1 SUBMISSION  v24.0  "LIGHT + RESUME"  (paper-ready)
 SINGLE CELL - paste this whole file into ONE Jupyter cell, or run as .py
================================================================================

This is the consolidated, final version of the pipeline for a classification
research paper: 27 lightweight baselines (<= ~12M params each) benchmarked
against one proposed model (MS-EGCA, MobileNetV3-Small backbone), full
statistical testing, ablation, corruption robustness, and cross-dataset
comparison - with automatic reuse of already-trained checkpoints.

MODEL ZOO (Aug 2026 lightweight literature review):
  Classic light CNNs   - SqueezeNet, ShuffleNetV2 (x0.5/x1.0), MobileNetV2/V3,
                          MNASNet, EfficientNet-B0, RegNetY-400MF.
  2022-2024 light SOTA - GhostNetV2 (NeurIPS'22), RepGhostNet, EdgeNeXt,
                          MobileViT / MobileViTv2, TinyViT, EfficientFormer,
                          RepViT (arXiv:2307.09283), FastViT (ICCV'23,
                          arXiv:2303.14189), StarNet "Rewrite the Stars"
                          (CVPR'24, arXiv:2403.19967), EfficientViT (MSRA/MIT),
                          SHViT (CVPR'24), MobileNetV4-Conv-S (2024).
  Optional             - YOLO11s-cls (~6.2M, only if `ultralytics` installed).
  Any timm model name not present in your installed timm version is skipped
  automatically (wrapped in try/except in make_timm()) - it will NOT crash
  the run, it just prints a warning and moves on.

RESUME SYSTEM (answering "kia already train model ko use karega?" - YES):
  Before anything trains, the script scans PROGRESS_DIR and CKPT_DIR and
  prints exactly what it found. For every model:
    layer 1: progress/<ds>__<id>__complete.pkl  (fastest, full metric recall)
    layer 2: checkpoints/<id>_best.pth  (or <id>.pth)  (raw weights only)
    layer 3: train from scratch (only if neither exists)
  Anything reused prints "[REUSED]"; nothing is retrained unnecessarily.
  All results (reused AND freshly trained) land in the SAME `all_results`
  list / `histories` dict, so every downstream table, figure, statistical
  test, and cross-dataset comparison uses both together automatically -
  this is what feeds your paper's results tables and figures.

WHERE YOUR CHECKPOINTS LIVE:
  BASE_DIR below defaults to the same folder your previous runs used
  (d:/python/study_1_militery/code/DT_Q1_FINAL_results). If your .pth or
  .pkl files are there, they are found and reused automatically. If you
  moved them, update BASE_DIR near the top of Section 1.
================================================================================
"""

FULL_RESULTS_LOG: List[str] = []


def emit(s: str):
    print(s, flush=True)
    FULL_RESULTS_LOG.append(s)


def hr(char: str = "-", width: int = 78, label: Optional[str] = None):
    if label is None:
        emit(char * width)
    else:
        pad = max(0, width - len(label) - 4)
        left = pad // 2
        right = pad - left
        emit(char * left + "  " + label + "  " + char * right)


def banner(s: str, ch: str = "="):
    emit("\n" + ch * 70)
    emit(s)
    emit(ch * 70)


def stage(i: int, n: int, s: str):
    banner(f"[STEP {i}/{n}] {s}")


def log(s: str):
    emit(str(s))


def sub(s: str):
    log("   >> " + str(s))


def ok(s: str):
    log("   [OK] " + str(s))


def warn(s: str):
    log("   [!] " + str(s))


def reused(s: str):
    log("   [REUSED] " + str(s))


def safe(s: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^\w\-.]+", "_", str(s)).strip("_")


def safe_write(path, content, mode="w", encoding="utf-8"):
    p = Path(path)
    try:
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"mkdir failed {p.parent}: {e}")
    try:
        with open(p, mode, encoding=encoding) as f:
            f.write(content)
    except PermissionError:
        time.sleep(0.5)
        with open(p, mode, encoding=encoding) as f:
            f.write(content)
    return p


def safe_makedirs(path) -> Path:
    p = Path(path)
    p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return p


def to_md(df: pd.DataFrame) -> str:
    if df is None or len(df) == 0:
        return "*(empty)*"
    cols = list(df.columns)
    lines = ["| " + " | ".join(map(str, cols)) + " |",
             "| " + " | ".join(["---"] * len(cols)) + " |"]
    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        vals = [f"{v:.4f}" if isinstance(v, float) else str(v) for v in row]
        lines.append("| " + " | ".join(vals) + " |")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def print_table_inline(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str, max_rows: int = 15):
    if df is None or len(df) == 0:
        print(f"\n[INLINE] {name}: (empty)")
        return
    print(f"\n{'-' * 70}")
    print(f"  [INLINE PREVIEW] {name}  ({len(df)} rows x {len(df.columns)} cols)")
    print(f"{'-' * 70}")
    if len(df) > max_rows:
        print(df.head(max_rows).to_string(index=False))
        print(f"  ... ({len(df) - max_rows} more rows in saved file)")
    else:
        print(df.to_string(index=False))
    print(f"{'-' * 70}\n")


def no_inplace(m: nn.Module) -> nn.Module:
    for mod in m.modules():
        if hasattr(mod, "inplace"):
            try:
                mod.inplace = False
            except Exception:
                pass
    return m


class ProgressTracker:
    def __init__(self, total: int, label: str = "models"):
        self.total = total
        self.done = 0
        self.label = label
        self.t0 = time.time()

    def step(self, name: str = ""):
        self.done += 1
        elapsed = time.time() - self.t0
        rate = elapsed / max(self.done, 1)
        eta = rate * (self.total - self.done)
        log(f"   [PROGRESS] {self.done}/{self.total} {self.label} | "
            f"elapsed {elapsed / 60:.1f}min | ETA {eta / 60:.1f}min"
            + (f" | last: {name}" if name else ""))

ALL_FIGURES_REGISTRY: List[Tuple[str, "plt.Figure"]] = []


def register_fig(fig, name):
    if fig is not None:
        ALL_FIGURES_REGISTRY.append((name, fig))
    return fig


def finalize_fig(fig, name, show=None):
    if fig is None:
        return
    register_fig(fig, name)
    do_show = (IN_JUPYTER or SHOW_FIGS_INLINE) if show is None else show
    if do_show and IN_JUPYTER:
        try:
            from IPython.display import display
            display(fig)
        except Exception:
            pass
    plt.close(fig)


def df_to_fig(df: pd.DataFrame, title: str):
    if df is None or len(df) == 0:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 2))
        ax.axis("off")
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, f"{title}\n(empty)", ha="center", va="center")
        return fig
    show_df = df.head(60)
    ncols = len(show_df.columns)
    fig_w = min(22, 1.2 + 1.1 * ncols)
    fig_h = min(24, 1.0 + 0.35 * min(len(show_df), 60))
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(fig_w, fig_h))
    ax.axis("off")
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", pad=14)
    cell_text = [[f"{v:.4f}" if isinstance(v, float) else str(v) for v in row]
                 for row in show_df.values]
    tbl = ax.table(cellText=cell_text, colLabels=list(show_df.columns),
                   loc="center", cellLoc="center")
    tbl.auto_set_font_size(False)
    tbl.set_fontsize(6.5)
    tbl.scale(1, 1.3)
    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig

# ============================================================================
# SECTION 1b - CAMOUFLAGE AUGMENTATION
# ============================================================================
CAMO_RNG = np.random.default_rng(20260101)


def make_camo_pattern(kind: str, size: int = 96) -> np.ndarray:
    base = np.zeros((size, size, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    palettes = {
        "forest": [(34, 89, 41), (56, 118, 47), (76, 95, 39), (24, 60, 28), (84, 110, 50), (40, 70, 35)],
        "desert": [(176, 144, 87), (197, 162, 100), (140, 115, 70), (215, 185, 120), (120, 96, 60), (188, 155, 95)],
        "urban":  [(85, 85, 85), (110, 110, 110), (60, 60, 60), (95, 95, 95), (130, 130, 130), (45, 45, 45)],
    }
    palette = palettes.get(kind, [(128, 128, 128)])
    for _ in range(18):
        cy = CAMO_RNG.integers(0, size)
        cx = CAMO_RNG.integers(0, size)
        r = CAMO_RNG.integers(8, 24)
        col = palette[CAMO_RNG.integers(0, len(palette))]
        yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:size, 0:size]
        base[(yy - cy) ** 2 + (xx - cx) ** 2 <= r * r] = col
    blurred = np.stack([uniform_filter(base[..., c], size=5, mode="reflect")
                         for c in range(3)], axis=-1)
    return np.clip(blurred, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)


CAMO_PATTERNS = {k: make_camo_pattern(k) for k in ("forest", "desert", "urban")}


class CamouflageAug:
    def __init__(self, p: float = 0.5):
        self.p = p
        self.kinds = list(CAMO_PATTERNS.keys())

    def __call__(self, img):
        if random.random() >= self.p:
            return img
        kind = random.choice(self.kinds)
        pat = Image.fromarray(CAMO_PATTERNS[kind]).resize(img.size, Image.BILINEAR)
        return Image.blend(img, pat, random.uniform(0.10, 0.30))


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 1c - DYNAMIC LABEL INFERENCE
# ============================================================================
def list_class_folders(split_dir: Path) -> List[str]:
    if not split_dir.exists():
        return []
    return sorted([p.name for p in split_dir.iterdir() if p.is_dir()])


def build_aliases_for(name: str) -> List[str]:
    aliases = {
        name, name.lower(), name.upper(), name.title(),
        name.replace(" ", "_"), name.replace("-", "_"),
        name.replace("-", " ").lower(), name.replace("_", " ").title(),
        name.replace("_", "-").lower(),
    }
    return [a for a in dict.fromkeys(aliases) if a]


def infer_labels_from_dir(data_dir: Path):
    train_classes = list_class_folders(data_dir / "train")
    if not train_classes:
        for cand in ["test", "validation", "val", "valid"]:
            c = list_class_folders(data_dir / cand)
            if c:
                train_classes = c
                warn(f"No 'train/' in {data_dir}; using '{cand}/' for labels: {train_classes}")
                break
    if not train_classes:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Cannot infer class labels from {data_dir}.\n"
            f"Expected: {data_dir}/train/<class_name>/image.jpg")
    n_class = len(train_classes)
    aliases = {i: build_aliases_for(n) for i, n in enumerate(train_classes)}
    return n_class, train_classes, aliases


def verify_class_splits(data_dir: Path, class_names: List[str]) -> bool:
    expected = {c.lower() for c in class_names}
    splits = ["train", "test", "validation", "valid", "val"]
    found_any = False
    all_ok = True
    for sp in splits:
        d = data_dir / sp
        if not d.exists():
            continue
        found_any = True
        present = {p.name.lower() for p in d.iterdir() if p.is_dir()}
        missing = expected - present
        extra = present - expected
        log(f"  [SPLIT] {sp}/  classes={sorted(present)}")
        if missing:
            warn(f"  [{sp}] MISSING class folder(s): {sorted(missing)}")
            all_ok = False
        if extra:
            warn(f"  [{sp}] UNEXPECTED class folder(s): {sorted(extra)}")
            all_ok = False
    if not found_any:
        warn("  No recognized split folders found!")
        return False
    return all_ok


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 2 - DEVICE
# ============================================================================
def pick_device() -> torch.device:
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        log(f"[Device] CUDA: {torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}")
        return torch.device("cuda")
    if DML_OK:
        try:
            dev = dml_backend.device()
            _ = (torch.ones(2, 2).to(dev) + torch.ones(2, 2).to(dev)).cpu()
            log(f"[Device] DirectML AMD GPU: {dev}")
            return torch.device(dev)
        except Exception as e:
            warn(f"DirectML smoke-test failed ({e}); falling back")
    if hasattr(torch.backends, "mps") and torch.backends.mps.is_available():
        log("[Device] Apple MPS")
        return torch.device("mps")
    log("[Device] CPU")
    return torch.device("cpu")


DEVICE = pick_device()
IS_CUDA = DEVICE.type == "cuda"
IS_DML = DEVICE.type == "privateuseone"
IS_MPS = DEVICE.type == "mps"
PIN_MEMORY = IS_CUDA

if not IS_CUDA:
    USE_AMP = False
    log(f"[Config] USE_AMP=False (device={DEVICE.type})")

if IS_CUDA:
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = CUDNN_BENCHMARK
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = True
    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = True

log(f">>> DEVICE={DEVICE} | IS_CUDA={IS_CUDA} | IS_DML={IS_DML} | "
    f"USE_AMP={USE_AMP} | PIN_MEMORY={PIN_MEMORY} | NUM_WORKERS={NUM_WORKERS}")


def seed_all(seed: int = 42):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if IS_CUDA:
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


def seed_worker(worker_id: int):
    info = torch.utils.data.get_worker_info()
    s = ((info.seed + worker_id) % (2 ** 32)) if info else ((42 + worker_id) % (2 ** 32))
    np.random.seed(s)
    random.seed(s)


def sync_device(device: torch.device):
    if device.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.synchronize()


def empty_cache():
    if IS_CUDA:
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()


def inference_ctx():
    return torch.no_grad() if (IS_DML or IS_MPS) else torch.inference_mode()


def move_to(tensor, device):
    return tensor.to(device, non_blocking=True) if IS_CUDA else tensor.to(device)


class _NullCtx:
    def __enter__(self):
        return None

    def __exit__(self, *a):
        return False


def amp_ctx(use_amp: bool):
    if use_amp and IS_CUDA:
        return torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.float16)
    return _NullCtx()


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 3 - TRANSFORMS
# ============================================================================
def build_transforms():
    train_steps = [T.Resize(256), T.CenterCrop(IMG)]
    if USE_CAMOUFLAGE_AUG:
        train_steps.append(CamouflageAug(0.5))
    train_steps += [T.ToTensor(), T.Normalize(IMGNET_MEAN, IMGNET_STD)]
    train_tf = T.Compose(train_steps)
    val_tf = T.Compose([T.Resize(256), T.CenterCrop(IMG),
                        T.ToTensor(), T.Normalize(IMGNET_MEAN, IMGNET_STD)])
    val_raw = T.Compose([T.Resize(256), T.CenterCrop(IMG), T.ToTensor()])
    return train_tf, val_tf, val_raw


train_transform = val_transform = val_transform_raw = None


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 4 - DATASETS
# ============================================================================
def scan_split_dir(split_dir: Path, class_names, class_aliases):
    items: List[Path] = []
    labels: List[int] = []
    if not split_dir.exists():
        return items, labels
    for cid, cname in enumerate(class_names):
        cd = None
        for alias in class_aliases.get(cid, [cname]) + [cname]:
            cand = split_dir / alias
            if cand.exists() and cand.is_dir():
                cd = cand
                break
        if cd is None:
            warn(f"  [{split_dir.name}] class '{cname}' not found - skipped")
            continue
        n = 0
        for p in sorted(cd.iterdir()):
            if not p.is_file() or p.suffix not in IMG_EXTS:
                continue
            if VERIFY_IMAGES_ON_SCAN:
                try:
                    with Image.open(p) as im:
                        im.verify()
                except Exception:
                    continue
            items.append(p)
            labels.append(cid)
            n += 1
        sub(f"  [{split_dir.parent.name}/{split_dir.name}/{cd.name}] {n} images")
    return items, labels


class KaggleVehicleDS(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, root, split="train", transform=None,
                 class_names=None, class_aliases=None):
        self.root = Path(root)
        self.split = split
        self.tf = transform
        self.items, self.labels = scan_split_dir(
            self.root / split, class_names, class_aliases)
        if self.items:
            ok(f"[{self.root.name}] {split}: {len(self.items)} imgs / {len(set(self.labels))} cls")
        else:
            warn(f"[{self.root.name}] {split}: 0 images found!")

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.items)

    def __getitem__(self, i):
        p, y = self.items[i], self.labels[i]
        try:
            im = Image.open(p).convert("RGB")
        except Exception:
            im = Image.new("RGB", (IMG, IMG), (128, 128, 128))
        if self.tf:
            im = self.tf(im)
        return im, y


class SubsetDS(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, base: KaggleVehicleDS, indices: List[int], tf):
        self.base = base
        self.indices = indices
        self.tf = tf

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.indices)

    def __getitem__(self, i):
        idx = self.indices[i]
        p, y = self.base.items[idx], self.base.labels[idx]
        try:
            im = Image.open(p).convert("RGB")
        except Exception:
            im = Image.new("RGB", (IMG, IMG), (128, 128, 128))
        if self.tf:
            im = self.tf(im)
        return im, y


class CorruptDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, base_ds, corruption="haze", severity=3):
        self.base = base_ds
        self.c = corruption
        self.s = severity

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.base)

    def __getitem__(self, i):
        x, y = self.base[i]
        if isinstance(x, torch.Tensor):
            x = T.ToPILImage()(x.clamp(0, 1))
        x = self._corrupt(x)
        return T.Normalize(IMGNET_MEAN, IMGNET_STD)(T.ToTensor()(x)), y

    def _corrupt(self, im):
        s = self.s
        if self.c == "haze":
            im = ImageEnhance.Contrast(im).enhance(max(0.1, 1 - s * 0.15))
            arr = np.array(im).astype(np.float32) + s * 12
            return Image.fromarray(np.clip(arr, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8))
        if self.c == "blur":
            return im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=s * 0.8))
        if self.c == "noise":
            arr = np.array(im).astype(np.float32)
            arr += np.random.randn(*arr.shape) * s * 8
            return Image.fromarray(np.clip(arr, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8))
        if self.c == "occlusion":
            arr = np.array(im).copy()
            h, w = arr.shape[:2]
            bh = max(1, int(h * 0.1 * s))
            bw = max(1, int(w * 0.1 * s))
            y0 = np.random.randint(0, max(1, h - bh))
            x0 = np.random.randint(0, max(1, w - bw))
            arr[y0:y0 + bh, x0:x0 + bw] = 0
            return Image.fromarray(arr)
        if self.c == "mud":
            arr = np.array(im).astype(np.int16)
            h, w = arr.shape[:2]
            n_sp = s * 3
            cy = np.random.randint(0, h, n_sp)
            cx = np.random.randint(0, w, n_sp)
            radii = np.random.randint(2, 8, n_sp)
            yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:h, 0:w]
            dark = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=np.int16)
            for cy_, cx_, r in zip(cy, cx, radii):
                m = (yy - cy_) ** 2 + (xx - cx_) ** 2 <= r * r
                dark[m] = np.maximum(dark[m], 60)
            arr -= dark[..., None]
            return Image.fromarray(np.clip(arr, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8))
        return im


class BinaryTempDS(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, root, split, classes, tf):
        self.root = Path(root)
        self.tf = tf
        self.items = []
        self.labels = []
        aliases = {i: build_aliases_for(n) for i, n in enumerate(classes)}
        sd = self.root / split
        if not sd.exists():
            return
        for cid, cn in enumerate(classes):
            cd = None
            for alias in aliases.get(cid, [cn]) + [cn]:
                if (sd / alias).exists():
                    cd = sd / alias
                    break
            if cd is None:
                continue
            for p in sorted(cd.iterdir()):
                if p.is_file() and p.suffix in IMG_EXTS:
                    self.items.append(p)
                    self.labels.append(cid)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.items)

    def __getitem__(self, i):
        p, y = self.items[i], self.labels[i]
        try:
            im = Image.open(p).convert("RGB")
        except Exception:
            im = Image.new("RGB", (IMG, IMG), (128, 128, 128))
        if self.tf:
            im = self.tf(im)
        return im, y


def find_val_split(root: Path) -> Optional[str]:
    for name in ["validation", "valid", "val"]:
        if (root / name).exists():
            return name
    return None


def make_loaders():
    if not DATA_DIR.exists():
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Dataset not found: {DATA_DIR}\n"
            f"Expected: {DATA_DIR}/train/<class_name>/image.jpg")
    log(f"Scanning dataset: {DATA_DIR}")
    train_ds = KaggleVehicleDS(DATA_DIR, "train", train_transform,
                               class_names=CLASS_NAMES, class_aliases=CLASS_ALIASES)
    if len(train_ds) == 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"0 images found in {DATA_DIR}/train/")

    val_split = find_val_split(DATA_DIR)
    has_test = (DATA_DIR / "test").exists()

    if val_split and has_test:
        val_ds = KaggleVehicleDS(DATA_DIR, val_split, val_transform,
                                 class_names=CLASS_NAMES, class_aliases=CLASS_ALIASES)
        test_ds = KaggleVehicleDS(DATA_DIR, "test", val_transform,
                                  class_names=CLASS_NAMES, class_aliases=CLASS_ALIASES)
    else:
        warn("No validation/ or test/ - using stratified 80/10/10 of train/")
        ip: Dict[int, List[int]] = {}
        for i, y in enumerate(train_ds.labels):
            ip.setdefault(y, []).append(i)
        rng = np.random.default_rng(2026)
        tri, vai, tei = [], [], []
        for y, idxs in ip.items():
            idxs = list(idxs)
            rng.shuffle(idxs)
            n = len(idxs)
            nt = max(1, int(round(n * 0.1)))
            nv = max(1, int(round(n * 0.1)))
            tei.extend(idxs[:nt])
            vai.extend(idxs[nt:nt + nv])
            tri.extend(idxs[nt + nv:])
        val_ds = SubsetDS(train_ds, vai, val_transform)
        test_ds = SubsetDS(train_ds, tei, val_transform)
        train_ds.items = [train_ds.items[i] for i in tri]
        train_ds.labels = [train_ds.labels[i] for i in tri]

    train_paths = {str(p.resolve()) for p in train_ds.items}
    for ds, nm in [(val_ds, "val"), (test_ds, "test")]:
        dp = ({str(p.resolve()) for p in ds.items}
              if hasattr(ds, "items")
              else {str(ds.base.items[i].resolve()) for i in ds.indices})
        ov = len(dp & train_paths)
        if ov > 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"DATA LEAKAGE: {ov} images in {nm} also in train!")

    kw = dict(num_workers=NUM_WORKERS, pin_memory=PIN_MEMORY,
              worker_init_fn=seed_worker)
    if NUM_WORKERS > 0:
        kw["persistent_workers"] = PERSISTENT_WORKERS

    tl = DataLoader(train_ds, BATCH, shuffle=True, drop_last=True, **kw)
    vl = DataLoader(val_ds, BATCH, shuffle=False, **kw)
    ttl = DataLoader(test_ds, BATCH, shuffle=False, **kw)
    sub(f"train={len(train_ds)} | val={len(val_ds)} | test={len(test_ds)}")
    return tl, vl, ttl


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 5 - MIXUP / CUTMIX / EMA
# ============================================================================
class MixUp:
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.2):
        self.alpha = alpha

    def __call__(self, x, y):
        lam = np.random.beta(self.alpha, self.alpha)
        idx = torch.randperm(x.size(0)).to(x.device)
        return lam * x + (1 - lam) * x[idx], y, y[idx], lam


class CutMix:
    def __init__(self, alpha=1.0):
        self.alpha = alpha

    def __call__(self, x, y):
        lam = np.random.beta(self.alpha, self.alpha)
        b, c, h, w = x.shape
        idx = torch.randperm(b).to(x.device)
        ratio = np.sqrt(1 - lam)
        ch, cw = int(h * ratio), int(w * ratio)
        cy, cx = np.random.randint(h), np.random.randint(w)
        y1, y2 = np.clip(cy - ch // 2, 0, h), np.clip(cy + ch // 2, 0, h)
        x1, x2 = np.clip(cx - cw // 2, 0, w), np.clip(cx + cw // 2, 0, w)
        mixed = x.clone()
        mixed[:, :, y1:y2, x1:x2] = x[idx, :, y1:y2, x1:x2]
        return mixed, y, y[idx], 1 - ((y2 - y1) * (x2 - x1) / (h * w))


class EMA:
    def __init__(self, model, decay=0.999):
        self.decay = decay
        self.shadow = {n: p.data.clone().to(p.dtype)
                       for n, p in model.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad}
        self.backup = {}

    def update(self, model):
        d = self.decay
        for n, p in model.named_parameters():
            if p.requires_grad:
                self.shadow[n].mul_(d).add_(p.data, alpha=1 - d)

    def apply(self, model):
        for n, p in model.named_parameters():
            if p.requires_grad:
                self.backup[n] = p.data.clone()
                p.data = self.shadow[n].to(p.dtype)

    def restore(self, model):
        for n, p in model.named_parameters():
            if p.requires_grad and n in self.backup:
                p.data = self.backup[n]
        self.backup = {}


def mixup_criterion(crit, pred, ya, yb, lam):
    return lam * crit(pred, ya) + (1 - lam) * crit(pred, yb)


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 6 - ATTENTION MODULES (all lightweight)
# ============================================================================
class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(ch, max(1, ch // reduction), bias=False), nn.ReLU(inplace=False),
            nn.Linear(max(1, ch // reduction), ch, bias=False), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, _, _ = x.shape
        return x * self.fc(self.pool(x).view(b, c)).view(b, c, 1, 1)


class CBAM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.ca = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, max(1, ch // reduction), 1, bias=False), nn.ReLU(inplace=False),
            nn.Conv2d(max(1, ch // reduction), ch, 1, bias=False), nn.Sigmoid())
        self.sa = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(2, 1, 7, padding=3, bias=False), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x * self.ca(x)
        avg = torch.mean(x, 1, keepdim=True)
        mx, _ = torch.max(x, 1, keepdim=True)
        return x * self.sa(torch.cat([avg, mx], 1))


class ECA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, gamma=2, b=1):
        super().__init__()
        t = int(abs((np.log2(max(ch, 2)) + b) / gamma))
        k = t if t % 2 else t + 1
        self.pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.conv = nn.Conv1d(1, 1, kernel_size=k, padding=k // 2, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.pool(x).squeeze(-1).transpose(-1, -2)
        return x * torch.sigmoid(self.conv(y).transpose(-1, -2).unsqueeze(-1))


class CoordAtt(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.pool_h = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((None, 1))
        self.pool_w = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, None))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(ch, max(1, ch // reduction), 1, bias=False),
            nn.GroupNorm(1, max(1, ch // reduction)), nn.ReLU(inplace=False),
            nn.Conv2d(max(1, ch // reduction), ch, 1, bias=False))
        self.bn = nn.GroupNorm(1, ch)

    def forward(self, x):
        n, c, h, w = x.shape
        xh = self.pool_h(x)
        xw = self.pool_w(x).permute(0, 1, 3, 2)
        y = self.conv(torch.cat([xh, xw], dim=2))
        ah, aw = torch.split(y, [h, w], dim=2)
        aw = aw.permute(0, 1, 3, 2)
        return x * torch.sigmoid(self.bn(ah + aw))


class MS_EGCA(nn.Module):
    """Multi-Scale Edge-Guided Channel Attention (proposed, lightweight)."""

    def __init__(self, ch):
        super().__init__()
        self.ek = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(1, 1, k, padding=k // 2, bias=False) for k in [3, 5, 7]])
        self.ef = nn.Conv2d(3, 1, 1, bias=False)
        self.eg = nn.Sequential(nn.GroupNorm(1, 1), nn.Sigmoid())
        t = int(abs((np.log2(max(ch, 2)) + 1) / 2))
        k = t if t % 2 else t + 1
        self.cp = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.cc = nn.Conv1d(1, 1, kernel_size=k, padding=k // 2, bias=False)
        red = max(4, ch // 16)
        self.mlp = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(ch, red), nn.ReLU(inplace=False),
                                 nn.Linear(red, 1), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, h, w = x.shape
        g = x.mean(1, keepdim=True)
        edges = [torch.sigmoid(k(g)) for k in self.ek]
        emap = self.eg(self.ef(torch.cat(edges, 1)))
        ch_ = self.cp(x).squeeze(-1).transpose(-1, -2)
        ca = torch.sigmoid(self.cc(ch_).transpose(-1, -2).unsqueeze(-1))
        alpha = self.mlp(x.mean(dim=[2, 3])).view(b, 1, 1, 1)
        return x * (1 - alpha) + x * emap * ca * alpha


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 7 - SOBEL EDGE PRIOR & CROSS-ATTENTION FUSION
# ============================================================================
class SobelEdgePrior(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch=3):
        super().__init__()
        kx = torch.tensor([[-1, 0, 1], [-2, 0, 2], [-1, 0, 1]], dtype=torch.float32) / 4.0
        ky = torch.tensor([[-1, -2, -1], [0, 0, 0], [1, 2, 1]], dtype=torch.float32) / 4.0
        self.register_buffer("kx", kx.view(1, 1, 3, 3))
        self.register_buffer("ky", ky.view(1, 1, 3, 3))
        self.gate = nn.Conv2d(1, in_ch, 1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        kx = self.kx.to(x.device)
        ky = self.ky.to(x.device)
        g = x.mean(1, keepdim=True)
        e = torch.sqrt(F.conv2d(g, kx, padding=1) ** 2 +
                       F.conv2d(g, ky, padding=1) ** 2 + 1e-6)
        e = (e - e.mean((2, 3), keepdim=True)) / e.std((2, 3), keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-6)
        return x * torch.sigmoid(self.gate(e))


class CrossAttentionFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cnn_dim, vit_dim, heads=4, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        cnn_dim = max(cnn_dim, 2)
        heads = min(heads, cnn_dim)
        while heads > 1 and cnn_dim % heads:
            heads -= 1
        self.heads = heads
        self.scale = (cnn_dim // heads) ** -0.5
        self.q = nn.Linear(cnn_dim, cnn_dim, bias=False)
        self.k = nn.Linear(vit_dim, cnn_dim, bias=False)
        self.v = nn.Linear(vit_dim, cnn_dim, bias=False)
        self.o = nn.Linear(cnn_dim, cnn_dim, bias=False)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(cnn_dim)

    def forward(self, cf, vt):
        b, d = cf.shape
        h, hd = self.heads, d // self.heads
        q = self.q(cf).view(b, h, 1, hd)
        k = self.k(vt).view(b, -1, h, hd).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        v = self.v(vt).view(b, -1, h, hd).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        a = self.drop(torch.softmax((q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scale, -1))
        return self.norm(cf + self.o((a @ v).squeeze(2).reshape(b, d)))


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 8 - PROPOSED MODEL (HybridDualAttn, light backbone)
# ============================================================================
class HybridDualAttn(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes, pretrained=True,
                 use_sobel=True, attn_type="MS_EGCA",
                 use_vit=True, use_xattn=True):
        super().__init__()
        self.use_sobel = use_sobel
        self.attn_type = attn_type
        self.use_vit = use_vit
        self.use_xattn = use_xattn and use_vit
        self.sobel = SobelEdgePrior(3) if use_sobel else nn.Identity()

        try:
            from torchvision.models import MobileNet_V3_Small_Weights
            base = torchvision.models.mobilenet_v3_small(
                weights=MobileNet_V3_Small_Weights.DEFAULT if pretrained else None)
        except Exception:
            base = torchvision.models.mobilenet_v3_small(weights=None)
        self.cnn_stem = base.features
        with torch.no_grad():
            cnn_d = self.cnn_stem(torch.randn(1, 3, IMG, IMG)).shape[1]

        self.pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        attn_map = {"SE": SEBlock, "CBAM": CBAM, "ECA": ECA, "CA": CoordAtt, "MS_EGCA": MS_EGCA}
        self.attn = attn_map[attn_type](cnn_d) if attn_type in attn_map else nn.Identity()

        self.vit = None
        vit_d = 0
        # DirectML guard: the proposed model must not silently carry the same
        # transformer-attention instability that C9 (DeiT-Tiny) was excluded
        # from the baseline zoo for (see HEAVY_OR_UNSTABLE_IDS). On DirectML
        # this branch is skipped by default - MS-EGCA still gets its full
        # Sobel + attention path, just without the frozen DeiT cross-attention
        # fusion. Set ALLOW_VIT_ON_DML=True (or run on CUDA) to include it for
        # the "full" ablation variant (A7/A8) on a cloud GPU.
        vit_blocked_here = use_vit and IS_DML and not ALLOW_VIT_ON_DML
        if vit_blocked_here:
            warn("HybridDualAttn: DeiT-Tiny/cross-attention branch DISABLED on "
                 "DirectML (same instability risk as baseline C9) - using "
                 "Sobel + attention-only path. Set ALLOW_VIT_ON_DML=True to "
                 "override (e.g. on CUDA/cloud for the full ablation variant).")
            self.use_vit = False
            self.use_xattn = False
        elif use_vit and TIMM_OK and IMG == 224:
            try:
                self.vit = no_inplace(timm.create_model(
                    "deit_tiny_patch16_224", pretrained=pretrained,
                    num_classes=0, global_pool=""))
                with torch.no_grad():
                    vit_d = self.vit(torch.randn(1, 3, IMG, IMG)).shape[-1]
                ok(f"DeiT-Tiny loaded (token_dim={vit_d})")
            except Exception as e:
                warn(f"DeiT-Tiny failed: {e}")
                self.use_vit = False
                self.use_xattn = False

        self.xattn = (CrossAttentionFusion(cnn_d, vit_d)
                      if self.use_xattn and vit_d > 0 else None)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Dropout(0.2), nn.Linear(cnn_d, num_classes))

    def train(self, mode=True):
        super().train(mode)
        if self.vit is not None and self.use_vit:
            self.vit.eval()
        return self

    def forward(self, x, return_features=False):
        f = self.cnn_stem(self.sobel(x) if self.use_sobel else x)
        if self.attn_type:
            f = self.attn(f)
        f = self.pool(f).flatten(1)
        if self.vit is not None and self.use_vit:
            with torch.no_grad():
                tok = self.vit(x)
            if tok.dim() == 3 and tok.shape[1] > 1:
                tok = tok[:, 1:, :]
            elif tok.dim() == 2:
                tok = tok.unsqueeze(1)
            if self.xattn is not None:
                f = self.xattn(f, tok)
        if return_features:
            return f
        return self.head(f)

    def get_features(self, x):
        return self.forward(x, return_features=True)


def build_hybrid(pretrained=True, sobel=True, attn_type="MS_EGCA", vit=True, xattn=True):
    m = no_inplace(HybridDualAttn(N_CLASS, pretrained, sobel, attn_type, vit, xattn))
    if m.vit is not None and m.use_vit:
        for p in m.vit.parameters():
            p.requires_grad = False
    return m


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 9 - BASELINES  [L1] LIGHTWEIGHT ONLY (heavy models removed)
# ============================================================================
def swap_head(m):
    for attr in ["classifier", "fc", "head"]:
        mod = getattr(m, attr, None)
        if mod is None:
            continue
        if isinstance(mod, nn.Linear):
            setattr(m, attr, nn.Linear(mod.in_features, N_CLASS))
            return no_inplace(m)
        if isinstance(mod, nn.Sequential):
            for i in reversed(range(len(mod))):
                if isinstance(mod[i], nn.Linear):
                    mod[i] = nn.Linear(mod[i].in_features, N_CLASS)
                    return no_inplace(m)
                if isinstance(mod[i], nn.Conv2d):
                    c = mod[i]
                    mod[i] = nn.Conv2d(c.in_channels, N_CLASS, c.kernel_size, c.stride, c.padding)
                    return no_inplace(m)
    return no_inplace(m)


def make_tv(name, pretrained):
    fn = getattr(torchvision.models, name)
    try:
        m = fn(weights=torchvision.models.get_model_weights(name).DEFAULT if pretrained else None)
    except Exception:
        m = fn(weights=None)
    return swap_head(m)


def make_timm(name, pretrained, drop_path=0.1):
    if not TIMM_OK:
        return None
    try:
        kw = dict(pretrained=pretrained, num_classes=N_CLASS)
        try:
            m = timm.create_model(name, drop_path_rate=drop_path, **kw)
        except TypeError:
            m = timm.create_model(name, **kw)
        return no_inplace(m)
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"timm.create_model({name!r}) failed: {e}")
        return None

# Heavy baselines intentionally REMOVED for this light-models run:
#   ResNet-50 (25.6M), ConvNeXt-Tiny (28M), Swin-Tiny (28M), MaxViT-Tiny (31M).
# YOLO11s-cls (~6M, optional) is added separately below only if ultralytics
# is installed - see BASELINES_YOLO / make_yolo11s().
# To bring any heavy model back, add a tuple to BASELINES_TV / BASELINES_TIMM.


class YOLO11ClsWrapper(nn.Module):
    """Thin classification wrapper around Ultralytics YOLO11s-cls (~6.2M params).
    Optional: only registered if ultralytics is installed AND the .pt weights
    can be fetched/found; any failure is caught and this baseline is skipped
    without affecting the rest of the pipeline."""

    def __init__(self, nc: int, pretrained: bool = True):
        super().__init__()
        if not ULTRALYTICS_OK:
            raise RuntimeError("ultralytics not installed")
        self.yolo = UltralyticsYOLO("yolo11s-cls.pt")
        self.model = self.yolo.model
        self.nc = nc
        self._ah = None
        self._replace_head(nc)

    def _replace_head(self, nc):
        try:
            la = lm = None
            for name, mod in self.model.named_modules():
                if isinstance(mod, nn.Linear):
                    la = name
                    lm = mod
            if lm is not None:
                nl = nn.Linear(lm.in_features, nc, bias=True)
                nn.init.kaiming_normal_(nl.weight, nonlinearity="linear")
                nn.init.zeros_(nl.bias)
                if la and "." in la:
                    parts = la.split(".")
                    parent = self.model
                    for p in parts[:-1]:
                        parent = getattr(parent, p)
                    setattr(parent, parts[-1], nl)
                elif la:
                    setattr(self.model, la, nl)
                ok(f"YOLO11-cls head: {lm.in_features} -> {nc}")
            else:
                warn("YOLO11-cls: no Linear layer found")
        except Exception as e:
            warn(f"YOLO11-cls head failed: {e}")

    def forward(self, x, return_features=False):
        try:
            out = self.model(x)
            if isinstance(out, (list, tuple)):
                out = out[0] if out else out
            if not isinstance(out, torch.Tensor):
                results = self.yolo(x, verbose=False)
                plist = []
                for r in results:
                    plist.append(r.probs.data if (hasattr(r, "probs") and r.probs is not None)
                                 else torch.zeros(1, self.nc, device=x.device))
                out = torch.cat(plist, 0)
            if out.dim() == 4:
                out = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(out, 1).flatten(1)
            if out.dim() == 2 and out.shape[1] != self.nc:
                if self._ah is None or self._ah.in_features != out.shape[1]:
                    self._ah = nn.Linear(out.shape[1], self.nc).to(x.device)
                out = self._ah(out)
            if out.dim() == 1:
                out = out.unsqueeze(0)
            return out
        except Exception as e:
            warn(f"YOLO11 forward: {e}")
            return torch.zeros(x.size(0), self.nc, device=x.device)

    def get_features(self, x):
        return self.forward(x, return_features=True)


def make_yolo11s(pretrained=True):
    if not ULTRALYTICS_OK:
        return None
    try:
        return YOLO11ClsWrapper(N_CLASS, pretrained)
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"YOLO11 build skipped: {e}")
        return None

]


def build_one(bid, name, fn, year, mtype):
    return {
        "id": bid,
        "name": name,
        "year": year,
        "type": mtype,
        "params_m": 0.0,
        "build_fn": (lambda f=fn: f(USE_PRETRAINED))
    }


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 10 - TRAINING ENGINE + [L2] 3-LAYER RESUME SYSTEM
# ============================================================================
def compute_auc_fast(probs, labels, n_class):
    try:
        present = np.unique(labels)
        if len(present) < 2:
            return float("nan")
        if n_class == 2 and len(present) == 2:
            return roc_auc_score(labels, probs[:, 1])
        return roc_auc_score(labels, probs[:, present],
                             multi_class="ovr", average="macro", labels=present)
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"AUC: {e}")
        return float("nan")


def run_one_epoch(model, loader, crit, opt, dev,
                  mixup_fn, cutmix_fn, ema, scaler, use_amp, train_mode=True):
    if train_mode:
        model.train()
    else:
        model.eval()
    tot_loss = tot_correct = tot_n = 0
    if train_mode:
        opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    ctx = torch.enable_grad() if train_mode else inference_ctx()
    with ctx:
        for i, (xb, yb) in enumerate(loader):
            xb = move_to(xb, dev)
            yb = move_to(yb, dev)
            use_mix = train_mode and mixup_fn is not None and np.random.rand() < 0.5
            use_cut = train_mode and cutmix_fn is not None and not use_mix and np.random.rand() < 0.5
            with amp_ctx(use_amp):
                if use_mix:
                    xm, ya, yb_, lam = mixup_fn(xb, yb)
                    out = model(xm)
                    loss = mixup_criterion(crit, out, ya, yb_, lam)
                    pred = out.argmax(1)
                    corr = lam * pred.eq(ya).sum().item() + (1 - lam) * pred.eq(yb_).sum().item()
                elif use_cut:
                    xm, ya, yb_, lam = cutmix_fn(xb, yb)
                    out = model(xm)
                    loss = mixup_criterion(crit, out, ya, yb_, lam)
                    pred = out.argmax(1)
                    corr = lam * pred.eq(ya).sum().item() + (1 - lam) * pred.eq(yb_).sum().item()
                else:
                    out = model(xb)
                    loss = crit(out, yb)
                    corr = out.argmax(1).eq(yb).sum().item()
            if train_mode:
                ls = loss / max(GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS, 1)
                if scaler:
                    scaler.scale(ls).backward()
                else:
                    ls.backward()
                if (i + 1) % max(GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS, 1) == 0:
                    if scaler:
                        scaler.unscale_(opt)
                        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP)
                        scaler.step(opt)
                        scaler.update()
                    else:
                        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP)
                        opt.step()
                    opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
                    if ema:
                        ema.update(model)
            tot_loss += loss.item() * xb.size(0)
            tot_correct += corr
            tot_n += yb.size(0)
    return tot_loss / max(tot_n, 1), tot_correct / max(tot_n, 1)


def validate(model, loader, crit, device):
    model.eval()
    loss = 0.0
    ps, ls, pbs = [], [], []
    with inference_ctx():
        for xb, yb in loader:
            xb = move_to(xb, device)
            yb = move_to(yb, device)
            out = model(xb)
            loss += crit(out, yb).item() * xb.size(0)
            pb = F.softmax(out, 1)
            ps.append(pb.argmax(1).cpu())
            ls.append(yb.cpu())
            pbs.append(pb.cpu())
    n = sum(len(l) for l in ls)
    loss /= max(n, 1)
    preds = torch.cat(ps).numpy() if ps else np.array([])
    labels = torch.cat(ls).numpy() if ls else np.array([])
    probs = torch.cat(pbs).numpy() if pbs else np.zeros((0, N_CLASS))
    if not len(labels):
        return loss, 0.0, 0.0, float("nan"), preds, labels, probs
    return (loss,
            accuracy_score(labels, preds),
            f1_score(labels, preds, average="macro", zero_division=0),
            compute_auc_fast(probs, labels, N_CLASS),
            preds, labels, probs)


def epoch_header(model_id: str):
    log(f"\n{'~' * 96}")
    log(f"  {'Ep':>4} | {'TrLoss':>8} {'TrAcc%':>8} | "
        f"{'VaLoss':>8} {'VaAcc%':>8} {'VaF1':>8} {'VaAUC':>8} | "
        f"{'Gap%':>6} | {'LR':>10}  {model_id}")
    log(f"{'~' * 96}")


def epoch_row(ep, n_ep, tl, ta, vl, va, vf1, vauc, lr, best_ep):
    gap = (ta - va) * 100
    marker = " *" if (ep == best_ep) else "  "
    auc_str = f"{vauc:8.4f}" if not np.isnan(vauc) else "     nan"
    log(f"  {ep:>4}/{n_ep:<4}| {tl:>8.4f} {ta * 100:>8.2f} | "
        f"{vl:>8.4f} {va * 100:>8.2f} {vf1:>8.4f} "
        f"{auc_str} | "
        f"{gap:>6.2f} | {lr:>10.2e}{marker}")


def cpu_state_dict(sd: dict) -> dict:
    """Ensure all tensors in a state_dict are on CPU (DirectML-safe)."""
    clean = {}
    for k, v in sd.items():
        clean[k] = v.detach().cpu() if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) else v
    return clean


def model_progress_path(ds_tag: str, model_id: str) -> Path:
    return PROGRESS_DIR / f"{ds_tag}__{model_id}__complete.pkl"


def load_progress_entry(ds_tag: str, model_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
    """Layer-1 resume: try to load a fully-finished result (no retrain).

    SANITY FLOOR: a cached entry whose accuracy sits at/near random-chance
    level is treated as poisoned (e.g. produced by a past cross-architecture
    checkpoint bug) and rejected, forcing a real re-run for that model
    instead of silently re-reporting garbage forever."""
    if not RECOVER_FROM_PROGRESS_PKL:
        return None
    if model_id in FORCE_RETRAIN_IDS:
        return None
    p = model_progress_path(ds_tag, model_id)
    if not p.exists() or p.stat().st_size == 0:
        return None
    try:
        with open(p, "rb") as f:
            blob = pickle.load(f)
        result = blob.get("result")
        if result and "acc_mean" in result:
            chance = 1.0 / max(N_CLASS, 2)
            if result["acc_mean"] < max(0.20, chance * 1.5):
                warn(f"  [PROGRESS-PKL] {model_id}: cached acc={result['acc_mean']:.2%} looks "
                     f"like a poisoned/garbage result (chance~{chance:.2%}) - IGNORING cache, "
                     f"will retrain. Delete {p.name} manually if this keeps happening.")
                return None
            return result
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"  [PROGRESS-PKL] Corrupt file for {model_id}, ignoring ({e})")
    return None


def save_progress_entry(ds_tag: str, model_id: str, result_entry: dict):
    try:
        path = model_progress_path(ds_tag, model_id)
        payload = {
            "ds_tag": ds_tag,
            "model_id": model_id,
            "result": result_entry,
            "saved_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        }
        with open(path, "wb") as f:
            pickle.dump(payload, f, protocol=pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL)
        return path
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"save_progress_entry({model_id}): {e}")
        return None


def find_pth_candidates(model_id: str) -> List[Path]:
    """Search several common checkpoint filename patterns for model_id so
    already-trained weights are found even if they came from an earlier
    version of this script (v19-v23) with slightly different naming."""
    patterns = [
        CKPT_DIR / f"{model_id}_best.pth",
        CKPT_DIR / f"{model_id}.pth",
        PROGRESS_DIR / f"{model_id}_best.pth",
    ]
    return [p for p in patterns if p.exists() and p.stat().st_size > 0]


def _param_signature(state_dict: dict) -> Dict[str, tuple]:
    """{param_name: shape} fingerprint of a state_dict, used to verify a
    checkpoint actually belongs to the architecture it's about to be loaded
    into - BEFORE any load_state_dict call is made."""
    return {k: tuple(v.shape) for k, v in state_dict.items()}


def state_dict_matches(model: nn.Module, state: dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """Strict structural check: same parameter names AND same shapes as the
    live model. This is the guard that stops a wrongly-named/mismatched
    checkpoint (e.g. MNASNet weights sitting in a file named for
    MobileNetV3-Small) from ever reaching load_state_dict - which is exactly
    how a silent strict=False fallback previously produced ~10% garbage
    accuracy. No partial/non-strict loading is used anywhere below."""
    model_sig = _param_signature(model.state_dict())
    ck_sig = _param_signature(state)
    if set(model_sig.keys()) != set(ck_sig.keys()):
        missing = set(model_sig) - set(ck_sig)
        extra = set(ck_sig) - set(model_sig)
        return False, f"key mismatch (missing={len(missing)}, unexpected={len(extra)})"
    for k in model_sig:
        if model_sig[k] != ck_sig[k]:
            return False, f"shape mismatch at '{k}': model={model_sig[k]} ckpt={ck_sig[k]}"
    return True, "ok"


def try_recover_pth(model_id: str, model: nn.Module) -> bool:
    """Layer-2 resume: load raw weights from checkpoints/<id>_best.pth (or a
    couple of backward-compatible alternate filenames).

    SAFETY GUARD: before load_state_dict is ever called, the checkpoint is
    verified to structurally match this model (same param names + shapes).
    New checkpoints written by this version are additionally tagged with
    their model_id (see train_model's save call) and that tag is checked
    too. Any mismatch = REFUSE to load and try the next candidate / fall
    through to training from scratch for this model only - never a silent
    non-strict partial load.

    Returns True if weights were loaded (caller should skip training)."""
    if not RECOVER_FROM_CHECKPOINTS or model_id in FORCE_RETRAIN_IDS:
        return False
    for pth_path in find_pth_candidates(model_id):
        try:
            raw = torch.load(pth_path, map_location="cpu")

            # new-format checkpoints (this version onward) are wrapped with
            # an explicit id tag; older/legacy files are a bare state_dict
            if isinstance(raw, dict) and "state_dict" in raw and "model_id" in raw:
                if raw["model_id"] != model_id:
                    warn(f"  [CKPT-PTH] {pth_path.name}: tagged for '{raw['model_id']}', "
                         f"not '{model_id}' - REFUSING (cross-model guard)")
                    continue
                state = raw["state_dict"]
            else:
                state = raw  # legacy raw state_dict from earlier script versions

            state = cpu_state_dict(state)
            ok_match, reason = state_dict_matches(model, state)
            if not ok_match:
                warn(f"  [CKPT-PTH] {pth_path.name}: architecture mismatch ({reason}) - "
                     f"REFUSING to load (this is the exact failure mode that used to "
                     f"silently produce garbage accuracy). Trying next candidate / "
                     f"will train from scratch if none match.")
                continue

            model.load_state_dict(state, strict=True)
            reused(f"Weights loaded from {pth_path.name} (layer-2 resume, arch-verified)")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            warn(f"  [CKPT-PTH] Failed to load {pth_path.name} ({e}) - trying next candidate")
    return False


def train_model(model_id, model, train_loader, val_loader, seed,
                use_mixup=False, use_cutmix=False, use_ema=False):
    seed_all(seed)
    dev = DEVICE
    try:
        model = model.to(dev)
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"Cannot move to {dev} ({e}); using CPU")
        dev = torch.device("cpu")
        model = model.to(dev)

    crit = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=LABEL_SMOOTH)
    opt = torch.optim.AdamW([p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad],
                            lr=LR, weight_decay=WD)
    sched = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(opt, T_max=max(RUN_EPOCHS, 1))
    mfn = MixUp() if use_mixup else None
    cfn = CutMix() if use_cutmix else None
    ema = EMA(model, EMA_DECAY) if use_ema else None
    use_a = USE_AMP and (dev.type == "cuda")
    scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler() if use_a else None

    best_f1 = 0.0
    best_st = None
    stale = 0
    best_ep = 0
    hist = {k: [] for k in ["train_loss", "train_acc", "val_loss", "val_acc", "val_f1", "val_auc", "lr"]}

    if RUN_EPOCHS > 0:
        epoch_header(model_id)

    for ep in range(1, RUN_EPOCHS + 1):
        tl, ta = run_one_epoch(model, train_loader, crit, opt, dev,
                               mfn, cfn, ema, scaler, use_a, True)
        if ema:
            ema.apply(model)
        vl, va, vf1, vauc, _, _, _ = validate(model, val_loader, crit, dev)
        if ema:
            ema.restore(model)
        cur_lr = float(sched.get_last_lr()[0]) if hasattr(sched, "get_last_lr") else LR
        sched.step()
        for k, v in zip(
            ["train_loss", "train_acc", "val_loss", "val_acc", "val_f1", "val_auc", "lr"],
            [tl, ta, vl, va, vf1, vauc, cur_lr]
        ):
            hist[k].append(v)

        # capture state_dict BEFORE any deletion happens (fix for the old bug)
        if vf1 > best_f1:
            best_f1 = vf1
            best_ep = ep
            best_st = cpu_state_dict(model.state_dict())
            try:
                torch.save({"model_id": model_id, "state_dict": best_st},
                           CKPT_DIR / f"{model_id}_best.pth")
            except Exception as e:
                warn(f"ckpt save: {e}")
            stale = 0
        else:
            stale += 1

        epoch_row(ep, RUN_EPOCHS, tl, ta, vl, va, vf1, vauc, cur_lr, best_ep)

        if va * 100 >= ACC_CEILING:
            warn(f"ACC_CEILING hit ep{ep}")
            break
        if (ta - va) * 100 > OVERFIT_GAP_THRESHOLD:
            warn(f"  ! Overfit {(ta - va) * 100:.1f}pp ep{ep}")
        if stale >= ES_PATIENCE:
            log(f"  # Early-stop ep{ep}  (best ep{best_ep} F1={best_f1:.4f})")
            break

    log(f"{'~' * 96}")
    log(f"  BEST -> ep{best_ep:3d}  F1={best_f1:.4f}\n")

    if best_st:
        try:
            model.load_state_dict({n: p.to(dev) for n, p in best_st.items()})
        except Exception as e:
            warn(f"load best: {e}")

    del opt, sched, crit
    if scaler:
        del scaler
    if ema:
        del ema
    gc.collect()
    empty_cache()
    return model, hist, best_f1, dev


def train_or_recover(model_id, model, train_loader, val_loader, seed,
                     use_mixup=False, use_cutmix=False, use_ema=False):
    """
    [L2] 3-layer resume:
      layer 1: caller already checked progress/*.pkl (full metrics) - handled
               one level up in run_dataset(), not here, because that layer
               skips model *construction* entirely.
      layer 2: try to load raw weights from checkpoints/<id>_best.pth. If
               found, SKIP TRAINING and return immediately.
      layer 3: train from scratch.
    """
    if try_recover_pth(model_id, model):
        model = model.to(DEVICE)
        hist = {k: [] for k in ["train_loss", "train_acc", "val_loss", "val_acc", "val_f1", "val_auc", "lr"]}
        # quick eval to populate best_f1 from the recovered weights
        crit = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=LABEL_SMOOTH)
        _, va_check, vf1, _, _, _, _ = validate(model, val_loader, crit, DEVICE)
        # second safety net on top of the structural arch-guard in
        # try_recover_pth(): if the resumed model still scores like random
        # guessing (e.g. weights matched shape but came from an unrelated
        # run), don't trust it - retrain instead of poisoning the results.
        chance = 1.0 / max(N_CLASS, 2)
        if va_check < max(0.20, chance * 1.5):
            warn(f"  [CKPT-PTH] {model_id}: resumed weights scored {va_check:.2%} val acc "
                 f"(chance level ~{chance:.2%}) - REJECTING and training from scratch instead.")
            return train_model(model_id, model, train_loader, val_loader, seed,
                               use_mixup=use_mixup, use_cutmix=use_cutmix, use_ema=use_ema)
        return model, hist, vf1, DEVICE
    return train_model(model_id, model, train_loader, val_loader, seed,
                       use_mixup=use_mixup, use_cutmix=use_cutmix, use_ema=use_ema)


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 11 - EVALUATION
# ============================================================================
def compute_extended_metrics(cm: np.ndarray, labels, preds, probs) -> dict:
    n = cm.shape[0]
    specs, npvs, fprs, fnrs, gmeans, lrps, lrns, dors = [], [], [], [], [], [], [], []
    for i in range(n):
        tp = float(cm[i, i])
        fn = float(cm[i, :].sum() - tp)
        fp = float(cm[:, i].sum() - tp)
        tn = float(cm.sum() - tp - fn - fp)
        sens = tp / max(tp + fn, 1e-8)
        spec = tn / max(tn + fp, 1e-8)
        npv = tn / max(tn + fn, 1e-8)
        fpr = fp / max(fp + tn, 1e-8)
        fnr = fn / max(fn + tp, 1e-8)
        gmean = float(np.sqrt(max(sens * spec, 0.0)))
        lrp = sens / max(fpr, 1e-8)
        lrn = fnr / max(spec, 1e-8)
        dor = lrp / max(lrn, 1e-8)
        specs.append(spec)
        npvs.append(npv)
        fprs.append(fpr)
        fnrs.append(fnr)
        gmeans.append(gmean)
        lrps.append(min(lrp, 9999.0))
        lrns.append(min(lrn, 9999.0))
        dors.append(min(dor, 9999.0))
    try:
        kappa = float(cohen_kappa_score(labels, preds))
    except Exception:
        kappa = float("nan")
    try:
        present = np.unique(labels)
        yb = label_binarize(labels, classes=list(range(n)))
        if yb.ndim == 1:
            yb = yb.reshape(-1, 1)
        bs = float(np.mean([brier_score_loss(yb[:, i], probs[:, i])
                            for i in present if i < probs.shape[1]]))
    except Exception:
        bs = float("nan")
    return {
        "specificity": float(np.mean(specs)),
        "npv": float(np.mean(npvs)),
        "fpr_macro": float(np.mean(fprs)),
        "fnr_macro": float(np.mean(fnrs)),
        "gmean": float(np.mean(gmeans)),
        "lr_pos": float(np.mean(lrps)),
        "lr_neg": float(np.mean(lrns)),
        "dor": float(np.mean(dors)),
        "kappa": kappa,
        "brier_score": bs,
        "per_class_specificity": specs,
        "per_class_npv": npvs,
        "per_class_fpr": fprs,
        "per_class_fnr": fnrs,
        "per_class_gmean": gmeans,
    }


def measure_inference(model, device):
    model.eval()
    x = torch.randn(1, 3, IMG, IMG).to(device)
    sync_device(device)
    with inference_ctx():
        for _ in range(LATENCY_WARMUP):
            model(x)
        sync_device(device)
        times = []
        for _ in range(LATENCY_RUNS):
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            model(x)
            sync_device(device)
            times.append((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000)
    return (float(np.mean(times)), float(np.std(times)),
            float(np.percentile(times, 50)), float(np.percentile(times, 95)))


def model_size_mb(model):
    return sum(p.numel() * p.element_size() for p in model.parameters()) / (1024 ** 2)


def edge_deployment_metrics(model, device):
    lm, ls, lp50, lp95 = measure_inference(model, device)
    return {"latency_ms_mean": lm, "latency_ms_std": ls,
            "latency_ms_p50": lp50, "latency_ms_p95": lp95,
            "fps_p50": 1000.0 / max(lp50, 1e-6),
            "params_m": sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()) / 1e6,
            "size_mb_fp32": model_size_mb(model)}


def evaluate_full(model, loader, device, use_tta=False):
    model.eval()
    ps, ls, pbs = [], [], []
    with inference_ctx():
        for xb, yb in loader:
            xb = move_to(xb, device)
            if use_tta:
                p1 = F.softmax(model(xb), 1)
                p2 = F.softmax(model(torch.flip(xb, [3])), 1)
                probs = (p1 + p2) / 2
            else:
                probs = F.softmax(model(xb), 1)
            ps.append(probs.argmax(1).cpu())
            ls.append(yb)
            pbs.append(probs.cpu())

    if not ps:
        e = np.array([])
        return dict(acc=0, f1=0, f1w=0, prec=0, rec=0, mcc=0, bacc=0,
                    auc=float("nan"), ece=0,
                    cm=np.zeros((N_CLASS, N_CLASS)),
                    preds=e, labels=e, probs=np.zeros((0, N_CLASS)), per_class=[],
                    extended={}, clf_report="")

    preds = torch.cat(ps).numpy()
    labels = torch.cat(ls).numpy()
    probs = torch.cat(pbs).numpy()
    acc = accuracy_score(labels, preds)
    f1 = f1_score(labels, preds, average="macro", zero_division=0)
    f1w = f1_score(labels, preds, average="weighted", zero_division=0)
    prec = precision_score(labels, preds, average="macro", zero_division=0)
    rec = recall_score(labels, preds, average="macro", zero_division=0)
    mcc = matthews_corrcoef(labels, preds) if len(set(labels)) > 1 else 0.0
    bacc = balanced_accuracy_score(labels, preds)
    try:
        present = np.unique(labels)
        auv = (roc_auc_score(labels, probs[:, 1])
               if N_CLASS == 2 and len(present) == 2
               else roc_auc_score(labels, probs[:, present],
                                  multi_class="ovr", average="macro", labels=present))
    except Exception:
        auv = float("nan")

    conf = np.max(probs, 1)
    corr = (preds == labels).astype(float)
    bi = np.clip(np.digitize(conf, np.linspace(0, 1, 16)) - 1, 0, 14)
    ece = 0.0
    for b in range(15):
        mk = bi == b
        if mk.sum():
            ece += mk.sum() / len(conf) * abs(corr[mk].mean() - conf[mk].mean())

    cm = confusion_matrix(labels, preds, labels=list(range(N_CLASS)))
    ext = compute_extended_metrics(cm, labels, preds, probs)
    try:
        clf_rep = classification_report(
            labels, preds,
            target_names=[CLASS_NAMES[i] if i < len(CLASS_NAMES) else f"cls{i}"
                          for i in range(N_CLASS)],
            zero_division=0)
    except Exception:
        clf_rep = ""

    per_class = []
    for i, nm in enumerate(CLASS_NAMES):
        tp = int(cm[i, i])
        fp = int(cm[:, i].sum() - tp)
        fn = int(cm[i, :].sum() - tp)
        tn = int(cm.sum() - tp - fp - fn)
        per_class.append({
            "Class": nm, "TP": tp, "TN": tn, "FP": fp, "FN": fn,
            "Precision": round(precision_score(labels, preds, labels=[i], average="macro", zero_division=0), 4),
            "Recall": round(recall_score(labels, preds, labels=[i], average="macro", zero_division=0), 4),
            "Specificity": round(ext["per_class_specificity"][i] if i < len(ext["per_class_specificity"]) else 0.0, 4),
            "NPV": round(ext["per_class_npv"][i] if i < len(ext["per_class_npv"]) else 0.0, 4),
            "FPR": round(ext["per_class_fpr"][i] if i < len(ext["per_class_fpr"]) else 0.0, 4),
            "FNR": round(ext["per_class_fnr"][i] if i < len(ext["per_class_fnr"]) else 0.0, 4),
            "G-Mean": round(ext["per_class_gmean"][i] if i < len(ext["per_class_gmean"]) else 0.0, 4),
        })

    return dict(acc=acc, f1=f1, f1w=f1w, prec=prec, rec=rec, mcc=mcc, bacc=bacc,
                auc=auv, ece=ece, cm=cm,
                preds=preds, labels=labels, probs=probs, per_class=per_class,
                extended=ext, clf_report=clf_rep)


def evaluate_corruption(model, base_ds, device):
    results = []
    for cname in CORRUPTION_TYPES:
        for sev in CORRUPTION_SEVERITIES:
            cd = CorruptDataset(base_ds, cname, sev)
            cl = DataLoader(cd, BATCH, shuffle=False, num_workers=NUM_WORKERS)
            ev = evaluate_full(model, cl, device)
            results.append({"corruption": cname, "severity": sev,
                            "accuracy": round(ev["acc"], 4), "f1": round(ev["f1"], 4)})
    return results


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 12 - STATISTICAL ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
def mcnemar_test(pa, pb, labels):
    ca = pa == labels
    cb = pb == labels
    b = int((~ca & cb).sum())
    c = int((ca & ~cb).sum())
    n = b + c
    if n == 0:
        return b, c, 1.0
    chi2 = (abs(b - c) - 1) ** 2 / n
    return b, c, float(stats.chi2.sf(chi2, 1))


def bootstrap_ci(pa, pb, labels, n_boot=2000):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    n = len(labels)
    diffs = np.empty(n_boot)
    for i in range(n_boot):
        idx = rng.integers(0, n, n)
        diffs[i] = (f1_score(labels[idx], pa[idx], average="macro", zero_division=0)
                    - f1_score(labels[idx], pb[idx], average="macro", zero_division=0))
    return float(diffs.mean()), float(np.percentile(diffs, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(diffs, 97.5))


def cohens_d(pa, pb, labels):
    d = (pa == labels).astype(float) - (pb == labels).astype(float)
    return float(np.mean(d) / (np.std(d) + 1e-8))

def save_table_md_csv_tex(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str, ds_tag: str, register_pdf=True):
    d = safe_makedirs(TAB_DIR / ds_tag)
    if df is None or len(df) == 0:
        warn(f"Table {name} empty")
        return None
    df.to_csv(d / f"{name}.csv", index=False)
    safe_write(d / f"{name}.md", to_md(df))
    try:
        safe_write(d / f"{name}.tex",
                   df.to_latex(index=False, float_format="%.4f",
                               caption=name, label=f"tab:{safe(name)}"))
    except Exception:
        pass
    if register_pdf and SAVE_TABLES_AS_PDF_PAGES:
        try:
            fig = df_to_fig(df, f"{ds_tag} - {name}")
            finalize_fig(fig, f"{ds_tag}_{name}_table", show=SHOW_TABLE_FIGS_INLINE)
        except Exception as e:
            warn(f"table->pdf page failed: {e}")
    print_table_inline(df, name)
    ok(f"Table: {ds_tag}/{name}")
    return d / f"{name}.csv"


def make_table_dataset():
    rows = []
    for sp in ["train", "validation", "val", "valid", "test"]:
        if (DATA_DIR / sp).exists():
            ds = KaggleVehicleDS(DATA_DIR, sp, None,
                                 class_names=CLASS_NAMES, class_aliases=CLASS_ALIASES)
            cnt = Counter(ds.labels)
            if cnt:
                rows.append({"Split": sp.capitalize(), "Total": len(ds),
                             "Classes": len(cnt), "Min": min(cnt.values()),
                             "Max": max(cnt.values()),
                             "Mean": round(np.mean(list(cnt.values())), 1),
                             "Median": int(np.median(list(cnt.values())))})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def make_table_stats(p0p, p0l, blp, bln, blf):
    rows = []
    for name, preds, bf1 in zip(bln, blp, blf):
        try:
            b, c, p = mcnemar_test(p0p, preds, p0l)
        except Exception:
            b, c, p = 0, 0, 1.0
        try:
            diff, lo, hi = bootstrap_ci(p0p, preds, p0l, BOOTSTRAP_N)
        except Exception:
            diff, lo, hi = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
        try:
            d = cohens_d(p0p, preds, p0l)
        except Exception:
            d = 0.0
        rows.append({"vs": f"P0 vs {name}", "b": b, "c": c,
                     "p-value": f"{p:.2e}" if p >= 1e-4 else "<1e-4",
                     "dF1%": round(diff * 100, 3),
                     "CI_lo": round(lo * 100, 3), "CI_hi": round(hi * 100, 3),
                     "Cohen_d": round(d, 3),
                     "BL_F1%": round(bf1 * 100, 2),
                     "sig": "Yes" if p < 0.05 else "No"})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
