def _sf(path, lbl=""):
    try:
        plt.savefig(path, dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight")
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"{lbl} save: {e}")


def plot_confusion_matrix(ev, title, save_path=None):
    cm = ev["cm"].astype(float)
    rs = cm.sum(1, keepdims=True)
    rs[rs == 0] = 1
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(6, N_CLASS * 0.8), max(5, N_CLASS * 0.75)))
    sns.heatmap(cm / rs, annot=True, fmt=".2f", cmap="Blues", ax=ax,
                xticklabels=CLASS_NAMES, yticklabels=CLASS_NAMES,
                cbar=False, vmin=0, vmax=1, square=True)
    ax.set_title(f"{title} | Acc={ev['acc'] * 100:.2f}% F1={ev['f1']:.3f}",
                 fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")
    plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha="right", fontsize=7)
    plt.setp(ax.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=7)
    plt.tight_layout()
    if save_path:
        _sf(save_path, "CM")
    finalize_fig(fig, title)
    return fig


def plot_ablations(abl_results, save_path=None):
    if not abl_results:
        return None
    names = [r["name"] for r in abl_results]
    accs = [r["acc"] * 100 for r in abl_results]
    f1s = [r["f1"] * 100 for r in abl_results]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 6))
    x = np.arange(len(names))
    w = 0.38
    ax.bar(x - w / 2, accs, w, color="C0", alpha=0.85, label="Accuracy (%)")
    ax.bar(x + w / 2, f1s, w, color="C1", alpha=0.85, label="F1 (%)")
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{r['id']}:{n[:16]}" for r, n in zip(abl_results, names)],
                       rotation=30, ha="right", fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel("Score (%)")
    ax.set_title("9-Variant Ablation", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
    ax.legend()
    ax.set_ylim(0, 105)
    plt.tight_layout()
    if save_path:
        _sf(save_path, "ablation")
    finalize_fig(fig, "ablation_study")
    return fig


def plot_corruption_robustness(corr_results, save_path=None):
    mat = np.zeros((len(CORRUPTION_TYPES), len(CORRUPTION_SEVERITIES)))
    for r in corr_results:
        if r["corruption"] in CORRUPTION_TYPES and r["severity"] in CORRUPTION_SEVERITIES:
            mat[CORRUPTION_TYPES.index(r["corruption"]),
                CORRUPTION_SEVERITIES.index(r["severity"])] = r["accuracy"] * 100
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5.5))
    sns.heatmap(mat, annot=True, fmt=".1f", cmap="RdYlGn", ax=ax,
                xticklabels=[f"Sev {s}" for s in CORRUPTION_SEVERITIES],
                yticklabels=CORRUPTION_TYPES, vmin=0, vmax=100,
                cbar_kws={"label": "Accuracy (%)"})
    ax.set_title("Corruption Robustness", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
    plt.tight_layout()
    if save_path:
        _sf(save_path, "corruption")
    finalize_fig(fig, "corruption_robustness")
    return fig


def plot_latency_acc(results_df, save_path=None):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 7))
    tc = {"CNN": "C0", "Transformer": "C1", "Hybrid": "C2", "Proposed": "red"}
    for t in results_df["Type"].unique():
        s = results_df[results_df["Type"] == t]
        ax.scatter(s["Latency_ms"], s["F1"] * 100, c=tc.get(t, "gray"),
                   s=450 if t == "Proposed" else 110, alpha=0.75, label=t,
                   edgecolors="black", linewidths=0.8)
    ax.set_xlabel("Latency (ms, batch=1)", fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylabel("Macro F1 (%)", fontsize=10)
    ax.set_title("Latency vs Accuracy Trade-off (Light Models)", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
    ax.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=9)
    plt.tight_layout()
    if save_path:
        _sf(save_path, "latency_acc")
    finalize_fig(fig, "latency_vs_accuracy")
    return fig


def plot_reliability_diagram(probs, labels, model_name: str, save_path=None):
    n = probs.shape[1] if probs.ndim == 2 else 1
    try:
        yb = label_binarize(labels, classes=list(range(N_CLASS)))
        if yb.ndim == 1:
            yb = yb.reshape(-1, 1)
        all_fp, all_mp = [], []
        for i in range(min(n, probs.shape[1])):
            fp, mp = calibration_curve(yb[:, i], probs[:, i], n_bins=10, strategy="uniform")
            all_fp.append(fp)
            all_mp.append(mp)
        fp_mean = np.mean(all_fp, axis=0)
        mp_mean = np.mean(all_mp, axis=0)
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"calibration_curve: {e}")
        return None
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 6))
    ax.plot(mp_mean, fp_mean, "C0-o", ms=7, lw=2, label="Model (macro-avg OVR)")
    ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], "k--", lw=1.5, label="Perfect calibration")
    ax.set_xlabel("Mean Predicted Confidence", fontsize=11)
    ax.set_ylabel("Fraction of Positives", fontsize=11)
    ax.set_title(f"Reliability Diagram - {model_name}", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax.legend(fontsize=9)
    plt.tight_layout()
    if save_path:
        _sf(save_path, "reliability")
    finalize_fig(fig, f"reliability_{model_name}")
    return fig


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 15 - MAIN PER-DATASET PIPELINE  (resume-first)
# ============================================================================
def run_dataset(ds_tag, data_dir, other_data_dir, other_label, prog):
    global DATA_DIR, N_CLASS, CLASS_NAMES, CLASS_ALIASES, DATASET_LABEL
    global train_transform, val_transform, val_transform_raw

    FULL_RESULTS_LOG.clear()
    banner(f"DATASET: {ds_tag}  |  {data_dir}", ch="=")
    DATA_DIR = data_dir
    if not DATA_DIR.exists():
        warn(f"Dataset not found: {DATA_DIR}")
        return None

    N_CLASS, CLASS_NAMES, CLASS_ALIASES = infer_labels_from_dir(DATA_DIR)
    log(f"  N_CLASS={N_CLASS}  Classes={CLASS_NAMES}")
    try:
        verify_class_splits(DATA_DIR, CLASS_NAMES)
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"  verify_class_splits failed: {e}")

    DATASET_LABEL = ds_tag.replace("_", " ")
    train_transform, val_transform, val_transform_raw = build_transforms()

    stage(1, 9, "Data loading & integrity")
    trl, vll, ttl = make_loaders()
    tls = str(sorted(int(y) for y in ttl.dataset.labels)) if hasattr(ttl.dataset, "labels") else ""
    fp = hashlib.sha256(tls.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    n_test = len(ttl.dataset)
    ok(f"Sealed test fingerprint: {fp}  (n={n_test})")

    safe_makedirs(PAPER_DIR / ds_tag)
    safe_write(PAPER_DIR / ds_tag / "sealed_test_fingerprint.txt",
               f"SHA-256[:16]: {fp}\nSamples: {n_test}\n"
               f"Timestamp: {datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}\n")

    BASELINES = BASELINES_TV + BASELINES_TIMM + (BASELINES_YOLO if ULTRALYTICS_OK else [])

    if DIRECTML_SAFE_ONLY:
        _kept, _skipped = [], []
        for b in BASELINES:
            if b[0] in HEAVY_OR_UNSTABLE_IDS:
                _skipped.append(b)
            else:
                _kept.append(b)
        BASELINES = _kept
        if _skipped:
            warn(f"  [DIRECTML_SAFE_ONLY] Skipping {len(_skipped)} model(s) known to be "
                 f"heavy/unstable on this GPU (set DIRECTML_SAFE_ONLY=False to include them):")
            for b in _skipped:
                warn(f"    - {b[0]} {b[1]}: {HEAVY_OR_UNSTABLE_IDS[b[0]]}")

    if IS_SMOKE:
        BASELINES = BASELINES[:3]

    stage(2, 9, f"Build model list ({len(BASELINES)} light baselines + 1 proposed)")
    roc_dir = safe_makedirs(FIG_DIR / "roc" / ds_tag)
    models_to_train = [build_one(*b) for b in BASELINES]
    models_to_train.append(
        build_one("P0", "MS-EGCA (Proposed, light)",
                  lambda p: build_hybrid(p, True, "MS_EGCA", True, True),
                  2026, "Proposed"))
    log(f"  {len(models_to_train)} model slots registered")

    # --- [L2] RESUME SCAN: layer 1 (progress .pkl) upfront -----------------
    reuse_count = 0
    for mi in models_to_train:
        cached = load_progress_entry(ds_tag, mi["id"])
        mi["_cached_entry"] = cached
        if cached is not None:
            reuse_count += 1
    if reuse_count:
        ok(f"  [RESUME] {reuse_count}/{len(models_to_train)} model(s) already complete "
           f"in progress/ - these will be REUSED, not retrained.")
    else:
        ok("  [RESUME] No progress/*.pkl found yet - will check checkpoints/*.pth next, "
           "then train anything still missing.")

    stage(3, 9, "Multi-seed training (resume-first)")
    all_results = []
    histories = {}
    lp_tracker = ProgressTracker(len(models_to_train), label=f"{ds_tag} models")

    for midx, mi in enumerate(models_to_train, 1):
        banner(f"MODEL {midx}/{len(models_to_train)}: {mi['name']}", ch="-")

        cached = mi.pop("_cached_entry", None)
        if cached is not None:
            reused(f"{mi['id']} - {mi['name']} loaded from progress/ "
                   f"(Acc={cached['acc_mean'] * 100:.2f}% F1={cached['f1_mean'] * 100:.2f}%)")
            cached["reused"] = True
            all_results.append(cached)
            prog.step(f"{ds_tag}:{mi['name']} (reused)")
            continue

        accs, f1s, f1ws, mccs, baccs, aucs, eces, lats = [], [], [], [], [], [], [], []
        fp_p = fp_l = fp_pr = fp_ev = fp_h = None
        any_pth_reuse = False

        for seed in SEEDS:
            seed_all(seed)
            try:
                m = mi["build_fn"]()
                if m is None:
                    warn("  Builder returned None - skip")
                    continue
                mi["params_m"] = sum(p.numel() for p in m.parameters()) / 1e6
                pth_existed = (CKPT_DIR / f"{mi['id']}_s{seed}_best.pth").exists()
                m, h, _, dev = train_or_recover(
                    f"{mi['id']}_s{seed}", m, trl, vll, seed,
                    use_mixup=USE_MIXUP, use_cutmix=USE_CUTMIX, use_ema=USE_EMA)
                if pth_existed:
                    any_pth_reuse = True
                ev = evaluate_full(m, ttl, dev, use_tta=USE_TTA)
                lm, _, lp50, lp95 = measure_inference(m, dev)
                accs.append(ev["acc"])
                f1s.append(ev["f1"])
                f1ws.append(ev["f1w"])
                mccs.append(ev["mcc"])
                baccs.append(ev["bacc"])
                aucs.append(ev["auc"])
                eces.append(ev["ece"])
                lats.append(lm)
                if fp_p is None:
                    fp_p, fp_l, fp_pr, fp_ev, fp_h = ev["preds"], ev["labels"], ev["probs"], ev, h
                if ev.get("clf_report"):
                    safe_write(RESULTS_DIR / f"clf_reports/{ds_tag}/{mi['id']}_s{seed}.txt", ev["clf_report"])
                try:
                    del m
                except Exception:
                    pass
                gc.collect()
                empty_cache()
            except Exception as e:
                warn(f"  seed={seed} FAILED: {e}")
                traceback.print_exc()

        if accs:
            tag = " [contains reused .pth weights]" if any_pth_reuse else ""
            ok(f"[MODEL DONE] {mi['id']} - {mi['name']}{tag} | "
               f"Acc={np.mean(accs) * 100:.2f}% +/- {np.std(accs) * 100:.2f} | "
               f"F1={np.mean(f1s) * 100:.2f}% | AUC={np.nanmean(aucs):.4f} | "
               f"params={mi['params_m']:.2f}M | lat={np.mean(lats):.1f}ms")
            histories[mi["name"]] = fp_h
            entry = {
                "id": mi["id"], "name": mi["name"], "year": mi["year"],
                "type": mi["type"], "params_m": mi["params_m"],
                "acc_mean": float(np.mean(accs)), "acc_std": float(np.std(accs)),
                "f1_mean": float(np.mean(f1s)), "f1_std": float(np.std(f1s)),
                "f1w_mean": float(np.mean(f1ws)), "mcc_mean": float(np.mean(mccs)),
                "bacc_mean": float(np.mean(baccs)), "auc_mean": float(np.nanmean(aucs)),
                "ece": float(np.mean(eces)), "latency_ms": float(np.mean(lats)),
                "preds": fp_p, "labels": fp_l, "probs": fp_pr, "eval": fp_ev,
                "reused": any_pth_reuse,
            }
            all_results.append(entry)
            save_progress_entry(ds_tag, mi["id"], entry)

            try:
                plot_confusion_matrix(fp_ev, f"{mi['id']} - {mi['name']}",
                    save_path=PER_MODEL_DIR / f"{mi['id']}_cm.png")
            except Exception as e:
                warn(f"CM {mi['id']}: {e}")
        else:
            warn(f"[MODEL FAILED] {mi['id']} - {mi['name']} produced no usable result")

        lp_tracker.step(mi["name"])
        prog.step(f"{ds_tag}:{mi['name']}")

    if not all_results:
        raise RuntimeError("No models available (trained or reused)")

    p0r = next((r for r in all_results if r["id"] == "P0"), None)
    if p0r is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Proposed model P0 missing")
    p0ev = p0r["eval"]
    p0p = p0r["preds"]
    p0l = p0r["labels"]

    abl = []
    if RUN_ABLATION:
        stage(4, 9, "Ablation study - 9 light variants")
        for aid, aname, sobel, attn, vit, xattn in ABLATION_CONFIGS:
            sub(f"  {aid}: {aname}")
            cached_abl = load_progress_entry(f"{ds_tag}_abl", aid)
            if cached_abl is not None:
                reused(f"{aid} loaded from progress/ (Acc={cached_abl['acc']*100:.2f}%)")
                abl.append(cached_abl)
                continue
            try:
                seed_all(SEEDS[0])
                m = build_hybrid(USE_PRETRAINED, sobel, attn, vit, xattn)
                m, h, _, dev = train_or_recover(aid, m, trl, vll, SEEDS[0],
                                                use_mixup=USE_MIXUP, use_cutmix=USE_CUTMIX, use_ema=USE_EMA)
                ev = evaluate_full(m, ttl, dev, use_tta=USE_TTA)
                abl_entry = {"id": aid, "name": aname, "sobel": sobel,
                            "attn_type": attn, "vit": vit, "xattn": xattn,
                            "acc": ev["acc"], "f1": ev["f1"],
                            "preds": ev["preds"], "eval": ev}
                abl.append(abl_entry)
                save_progress_entry(f"{ds_tag}_abl", aid, abl_entry)
                try:
                    del m
                except Exception:
                    pass
                gc.collect()
                empty_cache()
                ok(f"  [ABLATION DONE] {aid} Acc={ev['acc'] * 100:.2f}% F1={ev['f1'] * 100:.2f}%")
            except Exception as e:
                warn(f"  ablation {aid}: {e}")
                traceback.print_exc()
        ok(f"Ablation done: {len(abl)}/9")
    else:
        stage(4, 9, "Ablation SKIPPED")

    stage(5, 9, "Statistical analysis")
    bl_only = [r for r in all_results if r["id"] != "P0"]
    stats_df = make_table_stats(
        p0p, p0l,
        [r["preds"] for r in bl_only],
        [r["name"] for r in bl_only],
        [r["f1_mean"] for r in bl_only])
    sig = (stats_df["sig"] == "Yes").sum() if len(stats_df) else 0
    sub(f"Significant wins (p<0.05): {sig}/{len(stats_df)}")

    stage(6, 9, "Corruption robustness + cross-domain")
    seed_all(SEEDS[0])
    p0_final = build_hybrid(USE_PRETRAINED, True, "MS_EGCA", True, True)
    p0_final, _, _, dev = train_or_recover("P0_final", p0_final, trl, vll, SEEDS[0],
                                           use_mixup=USE_MIXUP, use_cutmix=USE_CUTMIX, use_ema=USE_EMA)
    vs = find_val_split(DATA_DIR)
    val_raw_ds = KaggleVehicleDS(DATA_DIR, vs or "test", val_transform_raw,
                                 class_names=CLASS_NAMES, class_aliases=CLASS_ALIASES)
    corr_res = []
    if RUN_CORRUPTION and len(val_raw_ds) > 0:
        corr_res = evaluate_corruption(p0_final, val_raw_ds, dev)
        sub(f"  Corruption: {len(corr_res)} conditions done")
    else:
        warn("Corruption test skipped - no validation images")

    bin_res = None
    if other_data_dir and other_data_dir.exists() and N_CLASS >= 2 and other_data_dir != DATA_DIR:
        try:
            bc = list_class_folders(other_data_dir / "test")
            if not bc:
                for sp in ["validation", "val", "valid"]:
                    bc = list_class_folders(other_data_dir / sp)
                    if bc:
                        break
            if bc:
                bsp = "test" if (other_data_dir / "test").exists() else (find_val_split(other_data_dir) or "train")
                bds = BinaryTempDS(other_data_dir, bsp, bc, val_transform)
                if len(bds) > 0:
                    bl = DataLoader(bds, BATCH, shuffle=False, num_workers=NUM_WORKERS)
                    p0_final.eval()
                    idx_m = 0 if (len(bc) == 2 and "mil" in bc[0].lower() and "mil" not in bc[1].lower()) else 1
                    mc, nc2, nt = [], [], 0
                    with inference_ctx():
                        for xb, yb in bl:
                            xb = move_to(xb, dev)
                            probs = F.softmax(p0_final(xb), 1).cpu().numpy()
                            for i in range(len(yb)):
                                (mc if int(yb[i].item()) == idx_m else nc2).append(float(probs[i].max()))
                            nt += len(yb)
                    bin_res = {
                        "n_total": nt, "ds_name": other_label,
                        "mil_conf": float(np.mean(mc)) if mc else float("nan"),
                        "norm_conf": float(np.mean(nc2)) if nc2 else float("nan"),
                        "conf_gap": (float(np.mean(mc) - np.mean(nc2)) if (mc and nc2) else float("nan"))}
                    sub(f"  Cross-domain: n={nt} gap={bin_res['conf_gap'] * 100:.1f}pp")
        except Exception as e:
            warn(f"Cross-domain: {e}")
            traceback.print_exc()

    em_all = {}
    if RUN_INTERP:
        stage(7, 9, "Interpretability + edge metrics")
        try:
            plot_reliability_diagram(
                p0ev["probs"], p0l, "MS-EGCA (Proposed)",
                save_path=safe_makedirs(FIG_DIR / "calibration" / ds_tag) / "P0_reliability.png")
        except Exception as e:
            warn(f"Interpretability: {e}")
            traceback.print_exc()
    else:
        stage(7, 9, "Interpretability SKIPPED")

    sub("Measuring edge-deployment metrics (light models) ...")
    for mi in models_to_train:
        try:
            seed_all(SEEDS[0])
            m = mi["build_fn"]()
            em = edge_deployment_metrics(m, DEVICE)
            em_all[mi["id"]] = em
            sub(f"  {mi['id']} {mi['name']:<28s} p50={em['latency_ms_p50']:5.1f}ms  fps={em['fps_p50']:5.0f}")
            try:
                del m
            except Exception:
                pass
            gc.collect()
            empty_cache()
        except Exception as e:
            warn(f"  edge {mi['id']}: {e}")

    stage(8, 9, "Tables")
    ds = ds_tag
    save_table_md_csv_tex(make_table_dataset(), "table1_dataset", ds)
    save_table_md_csv_tex(make_table_architectures(all_results), "table2_architectures", ds)
    save_table_md_csv_tex(make_table_main_results(all_results), "table3_main_results", ds)
    save_table_md_csv_tex(make_table_ablation(abl), "table4_ablation", ds)
    save_table_md_csv_tex(pd.DataFrame(p0ev["per_class"]), "table5_per_class", ds)
    save_table_md_csv_tex(stats_df, "table6_stats", ds)
    save_table_md_csv_tex(pd.DataFrame(corr_res) if corr_res else pd.DataFrame(), "table7_corruption", ds)
    save_table_md_csv_tex(make_table_edge_metrics(em_all, all_results), "table8_edge_metrics", ds)
    save_table_md_csv_tex(make_table_extended_metrics(all_results), "table9_extended_metrics", ds)

    clf_dir = safe_makedirs(RESULTS_DIR / "clf_reports" / ds_tag)
    for r in all_results:
        rep = r.get("eval", {}).get("clf_report", "") if r.get("eval") else ""
        if rep:
            safe_write(clf_dir / f"{r['id']}_clf_report.txt", rep)

    stage(9, 9, "Figures + report")
    fd = safe_makedirs(FIG_DIR / ds_tag)
    plot_confusion_matrix(p0ev, "Proposed MS-EGCA", fd / "P0_confusion_matrix.png")
    if abl:
        plot_ablations(abl, fd / "ablation_study.png")
    if corr_res:
        plot_corruption_robustness(corr_res, fd / "corruption_robustness.png")
    plot_latency_acc(
        pd.DataFrame([{"Model": r["name"], "Type": r["type"], "F1": r["f1_mean"], "Latency_ms": r["latency_ms"]}
                      for r in all_results]),
        fd / "latency_vs_accuracy.png")

    ext = p0ev.get("extended", {})
    n_reused = sum(1 for r in all_results if r.get("reused"))
    lines = [
        f"# Results Report - {ds_tag}  (v24.0 light + resume)",
        f"Generated: {datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}",
        f"Models reused (not retrained): {n_reused}/{len(all_results)}",
        f"\n## 1. Headline metrics (Proposed MS-EGCA, light)\n",
        to_md(pd.DataFrame([
            {"Metric": "Accuracy", "Value": f"{p0ev['acc'] * 100:.2f}%"},
            {"Metric": "Macro F1", "Value": f"{p0ev['f1'] * 100:.2f}%"},
            {"Metric": "Weighted F1", "Value": f"{p0ev['f1w'] * 100:.2f}%"},
            {"Metric": "Specificity", "Value": f"{ext.get('specificity', 0) * 100:.2f}%"},
            {"Metric": "G-Mean", "Value": f"{ext.get('gmean', 0) * 100:.2f}%"},
            {"Metric": "MCC", "Value": f"{p0ev['mcc']:.4f}"},
            {"Metric": "Kappa", "Value": f"{ext.get('kappa', 0):.4f}"},
            {"Metric": "AUC", "Value": f"{p0ev['auc']:.4f}"},
            {"Metric": "Params", "Value": f"{p0r['params_m']:.2f}M"},
            {"Metric": "Latency", "Value": f"{p0r['latency_ms']:.2f}ms"},
        ])),
        f"\n## 2. Main benchmark (light models)\n{to_md(make_table_main_results(all_results))}",
        f"\n## 3. Extended metrics\n{to_md(make_table_extended_metrics(all_results))}",
        f"\n## 4. Per-class\n{to_md(pd.DataFrame(p0ev['per_class']))}",
    ]
    if abl:
        lines.append(f"\n## 5. Ablation\n{to_md(make_table_ablation(abl))}")
    if corr_res:
        lines.append(f"\n## 6. Corruption\n{to_md(pd.DataFrame(corr_res))}")
    if em_all:
        lines.append(f"\n## 7. Edge metrics\n{to_md(make_table_edge_metrics(em_all, all_results))}")

    safe_write(RESULTS_DIR / f"REPORT_{ds_tag}.md", "\n".join(lines))
    safe_write(RESULTS_DIR / f"FULL_LOG_{ds_tag}.txt", "\n".join(FULL_RESULTS_LOG))
    ok(f"All outputs -> {RESULTS_DIR}")

    return {
        "all_results": all_results, "p0_result": p0r, "p0_eval": p0ev,
        "p0_preds": p0p, "p0_labels": p0l, "abl_results": abl,
        "corr_results": corr_res, "bin_res": bin_res, "edge_metrics": em_all,
        "histories": histories,
        "n_train": len(trl.dataset), "n_val": len(vll.dataset), "n_test": len(ttl.dataset),
    }


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 16 - COMBINE RESULTS ACROSS DATASETS
# ============================================================================
def combine_datasets_results(pdr, pdp0):
    banner("COMBINING RESULTS ACROSS ALL DATASETS", ch="=")
    ds_tags = list(pdr.keys())
    if not ds_tags:
        warn("No datasets to combine")
        return None
    rows = []
    for ds_tag, results in pdr.items():
        for r in results:
            ext = r.get("eval", {}).get("extended", {}) if r.get("eval") else {}
            rows.append({
                "Dataset": ds_tag, "ID": r["id"], "Model": r["name"], "Type": r.get("type", "-"),
                "Params(M)": round(r.get("params_m", 0), 2),
                "Acc(%)": round(r["acc_mean"] * 100, 2), "F1(%)": round(r["f1_mean"] * 100, 2),
                "AUC": round(r.get("auc_mean", 0), 4), "MCC": round(r.get("mcc_mean", 0), 4),
                "Spec(%)": round(ext.get("specificity", 0) * 100, 2),
                "G-Mean(%)": round(ext.get("gmean", 0) * 100, 2),
                "Kappa": round(ext.get("kappa", 0), 4),
                "Lat(ms)": round(r.get("latency_ms", 0), 2),
                "Reused": "Yes" if r.get("reused") else "No",
            })
    combined_long = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    save_table_md_csv_tex(combined_long, "combined_main_results_long", "combined")

    lines = ["# COMBINED RESULTS - All Datasets (v24.0 light + resume)",
             f"Generated: {datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}", ""]
    for ds_tag in ds_tags:
        p0 = pdp0[ds_tag]["eval"]
        ext = p0.get("extended", {})
        lines += [
            f"## {ds_tag}",
            f"- Accuracy: {p0['acc'] * 100:.2f}%",
            f"- Macro F1: {p0['f1'] * 100:.2f}%",
            f"- Specificity: {ext.get('specificity', 0) * 100:.2f}%",
            f"- Kappa: {ext.get('kappa', 0):.4f}",
            f"- AUC: {p0['auc']:.4f}", "",
        ]
    lines.append("## Combined Benchmark Table\n")
    lines.append(to_md(combined_long))
    safe_write(RESULTS_DIR / "COMBINED_REPORT.md", "\n".join(lines))
    ok("Combined report -> COMBINED_REPORT.md")
    return {"combined_long": combined_long}


def export_master_pdf(path=None):
    path = path or (PAPER_DIR / "ALL_RESULTS_MASTER.pdf")
    if not ALL_FIGURES_REGISTRY:
        warn("No figures registered - master PDF skipped")
        return None
    with PdfPages(path) as pdf:
        d = pdf.infodict()
        d["Title"] = "Defence Technology Q1 - MS-EGCA Results v24.0 (Light + Resume)"
        d["Author"] = "Automated Experiment Pipeline v24.0"
        d["CreationDate"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        for name, fig in ALL_FIGURES_REGISTRY:
            try:
                pdf.savefig(fig, bbox_inches="tight")
            except Exception as e:
                warn(f"PDF page '{name}' failed: {e}")
    ok(f"Master PDF written: {path} ({len(ALL_FIGURES_REGISTRY)} pages)")
    return path


# ============================================================================
# SECTION 17 - MAIN
# ============================================================================
def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    banner("DEFENCE TECHNOLOGY - Q1 SUBMISSION v24.0 (LIGHT MODELS + RESUME)")
    log(f"  DEVICE={DEVICE}  IN_JUPYTER={IN_JUPYTER}  RUN_EPOCHS={RUN_EPOCHS}  SEEDS={SEEDS}")
    log(f"  Light baselines: {len(BASELINES_TV) + len(BASELINES_TIMM)}  (+1 proposed)")
    log(f"  Resume: progress/*.pkl={RECOVER_FROM_PROGRESS_PKL}  checkpoints/*.pth={RECOVER_FROM_CHECKPOINTS}")

    prog = ProgressTracker(0, label="total models")

    if TRAIN_ON_DATASET == 1:
        first = ("DS1_primary", DATA_DIR_10CLASS, DATA_DIR_BINARY, "DS2_binary")
        second = ("DS2_binary", DATA_DIR_BINARY, DATA_DIR_10CLASS, "DS1_primary")
    else:
        first = ("DS2_binary", DATA_DIR_BINARY, DATA_DIR_10CLASS, "DS1_primary")
        second = ("DS1_primary", DATA_DIR_10CLASS, DATA_DIR_BINARY, "DS2_binary")

    pdr, pdp0 = {}, {}
    r1 = run_dataset(first[0], first[1], first[2], first[3], prog)
    if r1:
        pdr[first[0]] = r1["all_results"]
        pdp0[first[0]] = {"eval": r1["p0_eval"], "params_m": r1["p0_result"]["params_m"]}

    if PROCESS_BOTH_DATASETS:
        r2 = run_dataset(second[0], second[1], second[2], second[3], prog)
        if r2:
            pdr[second[0]] = r2["all_results"]
            pdp0[second[0]] = {"eval": r2["p0_eval"], "params_m": r2["p0_result"]["params_m"]}

    combined = None
    if len(pdr) >= 1:
        try:
            combined = combine_datasets_results(pdr, pdp0)
        except Exception as e:
            warn(f"combine_datasets_results failed: {e}")
            traceback.print_exc()

    try:
        export_master_pdf()
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"export_master_pdf failed: {e}")

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    banner("ALL DATASETS COMPLETE - v24.0")
    log(f"  wall_time_min={elapsed / 60:.1f}  outputs={RESULTS_DIR}")
    return {"pdr": pdr, "pdp0": pdp0, "combined": combined}

print(f"  DS2={DATA_DIR_BINARY}")

try:

except KeyboardInterrupt:

          "(progress/*.pkl + checkpoints/*.pth) - re-run to resume.")
except Exception as e:

    traceback.print_exc()
